english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT 80 (min 18 subscores; MBA requires 100), IELTS 6.5 (min 6.0 UG / 6.5 GR; MBA 7.5), Duolingo 110, OR official home-university letter confirming completion of >=1 semester of English-taught study at a 4-year university (RHET 1020 not named specifically, but English-medium university instruction exemption explicitly applies).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/North Carolina State/2024-2025/AY 2024-2025 Fact Sheet - Incoming Exchange - Study Abroad Office.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Fall: First day of classes Aug 17, 2026; Last day of classes Dec 1, 2026; Final exams Dec 3-9, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027 Spring: First day of classes Jan 11, 2027; Last day of classes Apr 27, 2027; Final exams Apr 29-May 5, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: Incoming exchange students pay tuition directly to their home institution rather than NC State.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: AY 2026-2027 incoming exchange costs: Mandatory Health Insurance $773.18/semester (Global Solutions Plan); SEVIS fee $220; ResNet internet $140 (on-campus residents); optional streaming/cable ~$35; Books $400-$600. Immunizations and HealthWeb compliance required.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: 2024-2025 Fact Sheet p. 4-5 listed ~$1,400/sem Student Blue prior rate; 2026-2027 financial-matters updates plan to $773.18.

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/North Carolina State/2024-2025/AY 2024-2025 Fact Sheet - Incoming Exchange - Study Abroad Office.pdf#page=4
housing_availability.notes: On-campus housing (https://housing.dasa.ncsu.edu/) has reserved spots for exchange students, though competitive and not guaranteed.

housing_notes.value: AY 2026-2027 on-campus housing: $3,970/semester (shared residence hall room) to $4,780/semester (Wolf Village apartment); meal plans $800-$3,176/semester (apply via https://housing.dasa.ncsu.edu/).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 visa ONLY (NC State does not issue F-1 visas for exchange students); submit DS-2019 request in Global Home with passport and official proof of funding covering living expenses, insurance, and fees. Mandatory OIS immigration check-in at orientation.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Confirmed with AY 2024-2025 Fact Sheet p. 5; exact DS-2019 minimum USD threshold not published on public page.

exchange_page_url.notes: Earlier Fact Sheet p. 5 also lists http://studyabroad.ncsu.edu/incoming-student/.

credit_system_and_load.value: US credit hours: full-time minimum is 12 credits/semester (UG) or 9 credits/semester (GR). Grading A-F.

course_restrictions_note.value: Excluded: College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Engineering. Must declare a major field and take the majority of courses in that major. Final semester NOT recommended if specific required courses or thesis work are needed for graduation.
